app_fee.value: The Arts & Sciences application fee is $50, and it is not refunded.

toefl_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets a TOEFL iBT composite of 94 (old scale).

also.quote: Our graduate program follows the College of Arts and Sciences English Language Proficiency Policy.

ielts_min.value: Arts & Sciences sets an IELTS overall band of 6.5.

deadline.value: Apply by January 1; the department considers later M.S. applications only.
deadline.quote: The deadline to be considered for admission is January 1

gre_general.value: The GRE General Test is not required but recommended.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General Test is not required, but they are recommended.

gre_subject.value: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test is helpful but less important than the General Test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Mathematics Subject Test score is also helpful, but it is less important than the General Test scores.

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: PhD students are funded through TA, RA or fellowship support, with tuition remission and a stipend.
funding.quote: PhD students are funded through teaching assistantships, research assistantships, or fellowships

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is required, and most applicants hold a bachelor's or master's in mathematics.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree or an equivalent degree is required

also.quote: Most applicants to our Ph.D. programs have a bachelor's or master's degree in mathematics

notes: One department offers the PhD in Mathematics and the PhD in Applied Mathematics. The Statistics and Data Science degree is an M.S. only.
name: PhD in Mathematics; PhD in Applied Mathematics
